patch_description: Replace the initial RZ rotation layer with an RX rotation layer to provide better SU(2) coverage. The original structure (RY+RZ_pre) was potentially less expressive due to the commutativity of RZ with both the IsingZZ feature map and the CZ entanglers, limiting the ability to explore non-Z basis states. Replacing one RZ layer with RX introduces non-commuting operations that are crucial for effectively exploring the Hilbert space and enhancing the expressivity of the classifier. The final RZ layer is retained to maintain the standard VQC block form.
